change_summary: Embed domain_policy once inside <instructions> and remove redundant <policy> block
reason_for_change: Deleting the second copy of the domain policy cuts its token count from the first-turn prompt, directly lowering mean cost per task while preserving behaviour because one complete copy of the policy remains.
